question: Which CAPEC patterns map to ATT&CK technique T1114.002 (Remote Email Collection), and what is that technique?

answer.headline: Gathered 2 record(s) from 2 source(s); 1 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: The CAPEC pattern Remote Services with Stolen Credentials (CAPEC-555) maps to the ATT&CK technique T1114.002. This technique, Remote Email Collection, involves adversaries targeting Exchange servers, Office 365, or Google Workspace to collect sensitive information by leveraging user credentials or access tokens.

records.name: Remote Services with Stolen Credentials
records.label: AttackPattern
records.description: This pattern of attack involves an adversary that uses stolen credentials to leverage remote services such as RDP, telnet, SSH, and VNC to log into a system. Once access is gained, any number of malicious activities could be performed.

results.query: MATCH (n:SubTechnique) WHERE n.attack_id IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(m) WITH n, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE type(r) END AS rel, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE startNode(r) = n END AS outgoing, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE head(labels(m)) END AS neighbour_label, count(m) AS cnt WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN rel IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {rel: rel, outgoing: outgoing, label: neighbour_label, count: cnt} END) AS raw WITH n, [f IN raw WHERE f IS NOT NULL] AS facets RETURN n.attack_id AS id, n.name AS name, n.properties_json AS properties_json, facets AS facets LIMIT 300

records.name: Remote Email Collection
records.label: SubTechnique
records.description: Adversaries may target an Exchange server, Office 365, or Google Workspace to collect sensitive information. Adversaries may leverage a user's credentials and interact directly with the Exchange server to acquire information from within a network. Adversaries may also access externally facing Exchange services, Office 365, or Google Workspace to access email using credentials or access tokens. Tools such as [MailSniper](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0413) can be used to automate searches for specific keywords.
